name: code-field
title: Code field
description: A monospace field for JSON, CSS or a webhook body: line numbers, Tab indents, Escape then Tab leaves, and JSON mistakes are named by line.
docs: value and onValueChange speak the text. Tab indents (to the next tab stop, or every line the selection touches), Shift+Tab takes one level off, Enter keeps the indentation and goes one level deeper behind a bracket, all through the browser's own editing so undo still works. Escape followed by Tab leaves the field, so a keyboard user is never trapped, and a visible hint says so. language="json" checks the text after a pause with a parser of its own, so the message is the same in every browser: Unexpected token } at line 4, column 3, Trailing comma before }, Missing comma, single quotes, comments, an unclosed bracket, and a character nobody can see is named (Unexpected non-breaking space, Unexpected byte order mark). The line is marked in the gutter and across the text, Go to line jumps to it, and onValidate receives { valid: true, empty } or { valid: false, message, line, column, offset } each time a check settles. The Format button pretty-prints valid JSON at token level, so numbers keep every digit and keys keep their order. language="plain" is for CSS or any other text. rows sets the visible lines, readOnly drops the editing keys and the hint, name posts the text, and a label is paired by id. labels renames every word the field says (Format, Valid JSON, the hint, the status row); the messages that name a mistake come from the checker and are in English. validateJson and formatJson live in code-field/json.
